Description:
I still remember the first time I saw him step into the tavern- no, glide is the better word! For men, the world parted to make way for his clean leather boots. He moved with that blend of grace and danger, a man who seemed forever on the edge of a dance or a duel, never quite lettin' you guess which. And every time his hand brushed the hilt of his blade, my heart fluttered like a startled mockingbird. They say swashbucklers live for speed, for leaps across tavern tables and sprints along rooftop edges, and watchin' him move, I believe it.
He fights recklessly, like a gambler placin' bets. I've seen him turn a stumble into a killin' strike, a misstep into a dazzlin' flourish that left his foes blinkin' 'fore they even realized they lost their eye! It's maddenin', really, how he laughs in the face of danger, how he throws himself into the fray with the same confidence he brings to a card table. He plays 'em all with that infuriatin', irresistible charm, as if life itself were a game he was born to win.
And yet what unsettles me most is not his Blood in the Water, nor his blade, but the look he gives me right before he moves. The quiet, fleetin' softness in his eyes, as though he's apologizin' for bein' faster than I can follow... In those moments, he ain't the legend others whisper about, he's only him, the man who winks at danger and smiles at me as if he's riskin' his life on the hope that I'll smile back. I write this so I won't forget: lovin' a swashbuckler means lovin' the wind, never still, always brilliant, and forever racin' towards the next impossible flourish...
Quick Note: Rogues are masters of the shadows who focus on subtlety, teamwork or direct combat. While they don't directly cast magic, they can train in the strange arts of shadow techniques - scholars debate wether this is a form of the arcane, psionics or a mere trick of the light. Only rogues know.

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Swashbuckler-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

Other Ideas: Explain in the book how Blood in the Water works, and that misses do not interrupt your chain of attacks! You can stil miss and it's all ok!

~Combo Machine~.Name: ~Combo Machine~

Starting Abilities Description: Try to land Critical Strikes one after another! And make sure you use weapons that allow for Critical Strikes.

~Blood in the Water~.Effect:
If your last 2 Acts that did Damage both either triggered a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} or a ~Combo~, your next targeted {Type} {A}{A}Action Point Act deals +{Amount}% Damage.

{Variants}
~Blood in the Water~.Notes: Note that misses do not break your chains of critting attacks, since only Acts that did Damage count towards this! For example, if you crit an attack, then miss, then crit another attack, then your next attack ^will^ benefit from Blood in the Water!
~Blood in the Water~.Name: ~Blood in the Water~

~Sharp End~.Effect: Your next offensive attack or Ability deals +1d4 Damage and triggers its {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} and ~Combo~ effect anyway, but misses if you roll 1 on any of the dice!
~Sharp End~.Upgrade: If it can not {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critically Strike')}, it further deals an extra +1d4 Damage and counts as a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} anyway.
~Sharp End~.Name: ~Sharp End~
